name: comp-592
title: Search Toggle Header
blurb: Navbar with search, test mode toggle, and settings buttons.
description: Header with search input, test mode toggle (switch), layout menu, info/notifications/settings buttons, and add button. Admin/dev-focused.
use_when: Admin or dev dashboards with toggleable test mode and quick access to multiple settings.
avoid_when: Public-facing interfaces; test mode toggle confuses end users.
a11y: Search input labeled. Test toggle is semantic switch with aria-label. Settings buttons labeled and keyboard-accessible.
